I have the full branch file set from the parallel review's tool results and completed an independent rubric pass.

```
Decision: REJECT

Findings:
- severity: blocking
  category: script-correctness
  criterion: runtime
  surface: telemetry/aggregate.py:table_cost_per_finding_fixed
  raw_text: review_tokens accumulates cohort_total_tokens(run) once per finding. One reviewer run that surfaces N findings contributes N× its token total to "total tokens" and tokens/found, so §13 cost-per-finding is inflated by findings-per-run.

- severity: blocking
  category: script-correctness
  criterion: runtime
  surface: telemetry/aggregate.py:table_per_reviewer_yield
  raw_text: tokens_spent sums cohort_total_tokens(run) for every finding in a (pos, severity) group. Shared source_run_id rows are counted repeatedly, so per-position token totals are not unique-run spend.

- severity: major
  category: under-fitting
  criterion: spec-compliance
  surface: PRD.md:§17
  raw_text: Rubric cross-cut requires §17 to anchor --enabled-tools with --model/--auto, telemetry split, and cross-family review. §17.1–17.4 cover model, --auto, panel, and telemetry split only; --enabled-tools is absent.

- severity: major
  category: spec-internal-consistency
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: tools/conventions/commit-body-recipe.md:Reviewer pass on a feature branch
  raw_text: Mandatory trailers require Telemetry-row on every invocation body. Example 2 (Role: reviewer) ships Model/Role/Reviewer-panel/Findings but omits Telemetry-row, so the worked example is not a compliant grep template.

- severity: major
  category: spec-internal-consistency
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: telemetry/SCHEMA.md:How the §13 efficacy questions read these files
  raw_text: SCHEMA cost path is runs⨝dispositions via disposition_commit_sha mapped to the fix run, summing run input+output tokens. aggregate.py instead sums disposition_tokens_* per fixed finding and never joins the fix run.

- severity: minor
  category: spec-internal-consistency
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: tools/conventions/commit-body-recipe.md:Dispositions trailer
  raw_text: Instruction text is "comma-separated disposition commits"; Example 3 uses F-<id>:<disposition>@<sha>. Grep templates diverge between rule block and worked example.

- severity: minor
  category: spec-internal-consistency
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: tools/conventions/model-discipline.md:The wrapper
  raw_text: Doc says unset DROID_MODEL_ID yields a one-line reminder. run-with-model.sh prints a multi-line §17.1 rule paragraph then exit 2. Refuse text matches the rubric; the operational doc does not.

- severity: minor
  category: spec-internal-consistency
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: .gitignore:telemetry comment
  raw_text: Comment names aggregator.py; committed script is telemetry/aggregate.py. Same split is otherwise correct (SCHEMA+script public; three JSONL paths ignored).

- severity: nit
  category: readability
  criterion: internal-consistency
  surface: tools/conventions/commit-body-recipe.md:Mandatory trailer lines
  raw_text: Rule says trailers end the body before Co-Authored-By; all three examples place Telemetry-row/Findings/Dispositions after Co-authored-by.

Family-self-id: xai

Reach: files-only

Notes: Inspected the seven listed paths at 45061f4 only. Refuse-default, telemetry-split halves, --data-dir/$TELEMETRY_DATA_DIR, and first_seen_in_panel_position 0/1..N encoding hold. Blocking cost double-count plus SCHEMA/aggregate cost-path mismatch and missing --enabled-tools block merge.
```
